Title: SSIS
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/ssis
Content: Solidatus SSIS Connector extracts sources, transformations and destination data flow components from Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) package and generates lineage between data flow components.
Title: Example Configuration
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/ssis/configuration/example-configuration
Content: logging:
  # Recommended logging
  level: # Alternative log levels = (INFO/DEBUG/TRACE/ERROR)
    root: INFO
    com.solidatus.ssis: INFO
# Agent mode example configuration
spring:
  profiles:
    active: connector
solidatus:
  api:
    host: "https://xyz-group.solidatus.com"
    token: "123abc45de789f0"
  agent:
    name: "My SSIS Connector Agent"
    type: "SSIS"
    description: "SSIS Connector Agent"
